param: N Total population size (season-specific; see N2012/13, N2013/14, N2014/15).
δt Discrete time step used in the transmission model (a quarter of a day).
β Transmission rate (rate at which new infections take place given a contact); used in λ(t)=β*I(t)/N.
λ(t) Force of infection at time t (frequency-dependent), proportional to total infectious individuals.
σ Daily rate of progression through exposed stages (E1→E2 and E2→I1). Implies mean latent/incubation period dL=2/σ.
γ Daily rate of progression through infectious stages (I1→I2 and I2→R). Implies mean infectious period dI=2/γ.
π Initial susceptibility (fraction of population susceptible at season start).
λ0 Initial infection rate parameter used in early exponential growth re-parameterisation (EGR).
ψ Exponential growth rate parameter used in early exponential growth re-parameterisation (EGR).
pICU Probability of ICU/HDU admission given infection.
μICU|E Mean time from infection to ICU/HDU admission (waiting time distribution).
σ2ICU|E Variance of time from infection to ICU/HDU admission (waiting time distribution).
η Negative Binomial over-dispersion (dispersion) parameter for weekly ICU/HDU admission counts.
